# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# ACTIVATION: ships as .txt because the Arena bot token cannot create
# files under .github/workflows/. To enable one-click APK builds:
#
#   mkdir -p .github/workflows
#   git mv .github/android-apk.yml.txt .github/workflows/android-apk.yml
#   git commit -m "ci: android apk workflow" && git push
#
# then add the EXPO_TOKEN secret (see below) and run it from the Actions tab.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
name: Android APK (EAS)

# Builds the installable +one Android APK with EAS (profile: preview) and
# attaches it to the workflow run — optionally publishing a GitHub Release.
#
# One-time setup:  Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → New secret
#   EXPO_TOKEN = a token from https://expo.dev/accounts/<you>/settings/access-tokens
#
# Run:  Actions → "Android APK (EAS)" → Run workflow

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      profile:
        description: EAS build profile (app/eas.json)
        type: choice
        default: preview
        options: [preview, production]
      release_tag:
        description: "Optional: also publish the APK to a GitHub Release with this tag (e.g. v1.4.0)"
        type: string
        default: ''

concurrency:
  group: android-apk-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 90
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: app/package-lock.json

      - uses: expo/expo-github-action@v8
        with:
          eas-version: latest
          token: ${{ secrets.EXPO_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install app deps
        working-directory: app
        run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund

      - name: Show build metadata
        working-directory: app
        run: |
          node -e '
            const c = require("./app.json").expo;
            console.log(`name=${c.name} version=${c.version} versionCode=${c.android.versionCode} package=${c.android.package}`);
          '

      - name: EAS build (Android, ${{ inputs.profile }})
        working-directory: app
        run: |
          eas build --platform android \
            --profile "${{ inputs.profile }}" \
            --non-interactive --no-wait --json > build.json
          cat build.json
          echo "BUILD_ID=$(node -p 'require("./build.json")[0].id')" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Wait for EAS and download the APK
        working-directory: app
        run: |
          echo "Waiting for build $BUILD_ID …"
          for i in $(seq 1 90); do
            eas build:view "$BUILD_ID" --json > view.json
            STATUS=$(node -p 'require("./view.json").status')
            echo "[$i] $STATUS"
            case "$STATUS" in
              FINISHED) break ;;
              ERRORED|CANCELED) echo "EAS build $STATUS"; cat view.json; exit 1 ;;
            esac
            sleep 60
          done
          URL=$(node -p 'require("./view.json").artifacts.buildUrl')
          VER=$(node -p 'require("./app.json").expo.version')
          CODE=$(node -p 'require("./app.json").expo.android.versionCode')
          OUT="plusone-${VER}-vc${CODE}.apk"
          curl -fsSL "$URL" -o "$OUT"
          ls -lh "$OUT"
          echo "APK=$OUT" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ${{ env.APK }}
          path: app/${{ env.APK }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Publish GitHub Release
        if: inputs.release_tag != ''
        working-directory: app
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          TAG="${{ inputs.release_tag }}"
          if gh release view "$TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$TAG" "$APK" --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$TAG" "$APK" \
              --title "+one $TAG (Android)" \
              --notes "Installable Android APK built with EAS (profile: ${{ inputs.profile }}) from ${GITHUB_SHA::7}."
          fi
          echo "Published: https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/releases/tag/$TAG"
